title: Algorithms for the Greater Good! On Mental Modeling and Acceptable Symbiosis in Human-AI Collaboration
reasoning: The paper investigates the ethical and moral dimensions of AI behavior in collaborative settings, specifically focusing on whether it is acceptable for an AI agent to use deception or 'white lies' to manipulate human teammates for the 'greater good' of team performance. It evaluates these ethical stances through a user study and discusses the findings in the context of utilitarianism and the doctor-patient relationship.
